valid_owner_signature_exists.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner exists and is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_signature_derivable.meaning: an observer can derive a high-s counterpart of the valid owner signature via s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1, recovering the identical signer address

high_s_triggers_invalid_s_branch.meaning: a high-s signature causes OpenZeppelin ECDSA tryRecover to return RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS

validation_returns_failed_without_revert.meaning: signature validation returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting on the high-s signature mismatch

wallet_serviced_by_bundlers.meaning: bundlers continue to service (do not deprioritize or refuse) the targeted AtomWallet, preserving its ERC-4337 transaction ability

assumptions: The high-s signature is a 65-byte signature, so the README known issue on signature length does not exclude it.
The adversary is an observer of the public on-chain signature and needs no special authorization.
EntryPoint calls validateUserOp without try/catch during handleOps.

unresolved.description: Report describes wallet degradation as potential and does not state an observable numeric or state relation linking a validation revert to bundler deprioritization/refusal; represented as a grounded Boolean outcome.

limitations: Impact is described as potential; no observed griefing transaction is reported.
Whether the validation revert propagates to handleOps depends on EntryPoint version and bundler implementation.
The wallet-servicing outcome is a qualitative Boolean without a numeric definition; code binding is deferred.
